Based on the scientific facts regarding Hansen's disease (leprosy), physical touch does not possess any bactericidal or therapeutic properties and therefore cannot cure a bacterial infection. Leprosy is successfully treated and cured using Multidrug Therapy (MDT), consisting of specific antibiotics such as rifampicin, dapsone, and clofazimine.
